# memoato
Last updated: 2026-10-17

Memoato combines personal memory and source-backed context for AI-assisted work.
Personal memory saves original notes before interpretation, supports review,
and returns source evidence during recall. Project context is a single-owner,
read-only GitHub/Linear pilot with human claim review and access/freshness checks.
The pilot is not open multi-user team signup.

Key links:
- Personal memory: https://memoato.com/#how-it-works
- AI Context pilot: https://memoato.com/#ai-context
- Web app: https://app.memoato.com/
- Help and MCP setup: https://memoato.com/help/#connect-mcp
- Storage and AI processing: https://memoato.com/privacy-first/
- Privacy policy: https://memoato.com/privacy/
- About: https://memoato.com/about/
- Journal: https://memoato.com/blog/
- Open source: https://memoato.com/open-source/
- Repository: https://github.com/hrvojepavlinovic/memoato-app
- Contact: https://memoato.com/contact/

Cloud memory and MCP are separate from encrypted category titles/per-entry
notes and local-only category logging. Read the privacy explanation for scope,
AI processing, and the consequences of changing storage mode. API keys are
scoped and revocable. Context access requires a configured pilot workspace.
